summary: Premise is false. The ES cubic 4xyz = p(xy+yz+zx)w has three A1 nodes at the coordinate points (Gröbner basis: the gradient vanishes there; the quadratic part has discriminant p² ≠ 0), and its minimal resolution is a weak del Pezzo surface of degree 3 with Pic ≅ I^{1,6}; in that lattice no nonzero class has D²=0 and K·D=0 (Cauchy–Schwarz), so there is no genus-one fibration at all. The pencil through x=y=0 splits as a line plus a conic (conic bundle only), so there are no genus-one fibres to compute ranks of.
not_done: Rank computations not attempted (no object).
next: Replace the proposal by a conic-bundle analysis (fibres = conics through the nodes) if a Brauer/Selmer question is wanted.
